annotations.title: Seal an action into the transparency log

description: Seals the hashes of an AI action into GBLIN's public append-only RFC 6962 transparency log (free demo, 5 per day per IP, receipt marked demo: true). Returns a portable receipt: Ed25519 signature, Merkle inclusion proof and operator-signed C2SP checkpoint, verifiable offline with the zero-dependency verify-receipt.mjs. Input and output go in as sha256 hashes only; the action label and metadata are published in the public log. Unlimited sealing is a separate paid x402 HTTP endpoint (0.0045 USDC per seal).

action.description: Short public label of the action, e.g. 'trade.executed' or 'report.generated'. Published in the log — never put secrets here.

agent_id.description: Optional public identifier of the agent (published in the log).

input_hash.description: sha256 of the action input, as 64 lowercase hex chars. Hash locally; never send content.

output_hash.description: Optional sha256 of the action output (64 lowercase hex chars).

tool.description: Optional name of the tool/model that produced the action (published).

name: seal_action_demo
